channel.title: VISIONE Wire
channel.description: Global news, gaming, entertainment, business, markets, technology, artificial intelligence, policy and culture from VISIONE Wire.

item.title: Fed's Warsh puts inflation first at Jackson Hole and says AI could reshape growth
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high, the 2% target is fixed and AI could become a new factor of production while arguing for less routine forward guidance.

item.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's Anthropic blacklisting in major AI military ruling
item.description: A federal judge ruled the Pentagon's Anthropic supply-chain blacklist unlawful, finding First Amendment retaliation, due-process violations and arbitrary agency action.

item.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition launches on Switch 2 with patch 1.17 and new classes
item.description: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition launches August 28 on Nintendo Switch 2 with Shadow of the Erdtree, two new starting classes, new gear and Torrent customization, while patch 1.17 adds Tarnished Pack support elsewhere.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and 100+ groups warn AI cyberattacks will surge within months
item.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, AWS and more than 100 organizations are urging governments and critical-infrastructure operators to strengthen cyber defenses before AI-enabled attacks become more widespread and sophisticated.

item.title: Salesforce and Anthropic launch Claudeforce with 37 AI sales skills
item.description: Salesforce and Anthropic launched Claudeforce, starting with a Salesforce-in-Claude plugin that brings 37 prebuilt sales skills, governed CRM data and actions into Claude.

item.title: Samsung Odyssey G6 hits 1,100Hz as 2027 gaming monitor lineup debuts
item.description: Samsung unveiled its 2027 Odyssey gaming monitor lineup at Gamescom 2026, led by a 27-inch Odyssey G6 reaching up to 1,100Hz in HD.

item.title: Nvidia Q2 revenue hits $96.2 billion as data center sales double
item.description: Updated August 27: Nvidia's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 106% year over year, Data Center reached $89.0 billion and Q3 guidance is $108 billion plus or minus 2%.

item.title: PlayStation Plus September 2026 games: Sniper Elite, MLB The Show 26, Wobbly Life and Chained Echoes
item.description: Sony has announced four PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for September 2026: Sniper Elite: Resistance, MLB The Show 26, Wobbly Life and Chained Echoes, available from September 1.

item.title: Xbox 25th Anniversary console costs $899.99: preorder time, launch date and what is included
item.description: Microsoft has priced the Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition collection at $899.99. Broad preorders open August 27 ahead of a November 13, 2026 launch.

item.title: AI security market to reach $4.8 billion in 2027, Gartner forecasts
item.description: Gartner forecasts spending on securing AI will rise 68.7% to $4.783 billion in 2027 as agentic AI, prompt injection and access-control risk expand the market.

item.title: Stability AI raises $76 million from EA, Sony Music, Universal, Warner and others
item.description: Stability AI raised a $76 million Series B backed by Electronic Arts, Sony Music Group, Universal Music Group, Warner Music Group and other investors.

item.title: Nvidia releases DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction with Gamescom RTX push
item.description: Nvidia released DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction with a second-generation transformer model and a wave of new Gamescom RTX integrations.

item.title: OpenAI says Jalapeño chip beats leading AI accelerators on speed and efficiency
item.description: OpenAI published the first measured results for Jalapeño, its custom inference chip, claiming higher throughput per watt and lower latency across GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K2.5.

item.title: Gamescom Award 2026 nominees: Metro 2039 leads, Alien: Isolation 2 and Denshattack! follow
item.description: Metro 2039 leads the official Gamescom Award 2026 nominations with five nods; Alien: Isolation 2 and Denshattack! have four each, with public voting opening August 26.

item.title: Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live: Witcher 3 Remastered, Songs of the Past and biggest reveals
item.description: Updated August 26: The Witcher 3 Remastered launches September 29 as a free upgrade, while Songs of the Past reveals Letten, Switch 2 support and a 2027 release window.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 beta: new movement, maps and open beta dates
item.description: Infinity Ward is testing a faster, more fluid version of grounded Call of Duty multiplayer before the public open beta begins August 28.
